title: What Changed? Investigating Debiasing Methods using Causal Mediation Analysis

bias_targets.methodology: Measured using CrowS-Pairs (comparing the pseudo-likelihood of stereotypical versus anti-stereotypical sentence pairs), SEAT (assessing implicit associations between male/female names and attributes like career/family), and Causal Mediation Analysis (quantifying the direct and indirect effects of counterfactual gender pronoun substitutions, such as swapping 'he' and 'she', on internal model components like neurons and attention heads given profession-related prompts). Furthermore, the impact of debiasing on downstream tasks is evaluated using toxicity detection datasets (Jigsaw and RtGender).
